Aurora

the Witch Between Worlds
Mid laneTop lane

Aurora top uses her range and mobility to bully melee top laners. Her Q pokes, W makes her invisible, and E slows and hops her back, so bruisers struggle to catch her. She needs to avoid champions who out-duel her, but against slow melee champions she's very strong.

When to pick Aurora

✗ Better as a counter-pick

Mobile assassins beat her, so it's safer to pick her after you see the enemy top laner.

Pick into

  • Slow melee bruisers like Darius or Volibear
  • Champions without dashes, like Trundle
  • Teams without much hard crowd control

Avoid into

  • Mobile assassins like Yasuo and Akali
  • Tanky top laners who outlast poke, like Sion
  • Teams with lots of hard crowd control

Great teammates

Jarvan IVHis engage locks enemies in place for your burst.
ViHer point-and-click ultimate sets up your combo.
LeonaHer engage gives you easy targets.

Your team needs: A frontline and engage, so you can stay at range and burst.

How to read the enemy team → · Practice drafting →

Strengths

  • Ranged against melee top laners: you can poke them freely
  • W and E give you escapes from ganks and all-ins
  • Strong burst after Stormsurge and Shadowflame
  • Her ultimate zone traps bruisers and gives you a way to escape

Weaknesses

  • Mobile assassins like Akali and Yasuo beat her
  • Fragile: a single mistake against bruisers can kill her
  • Tanks with sustain can outlast her poke
  • Needs items before she can kill tanks

Power spikes

  • Level 2: Q poke plus E lets you win early trades against melee champions
  • Level 6: Between Worlds gives you kill pressure and a strong escape
  • First item (Stormsurge): your burst starts killing squishy targets
  • Second item (Shadowflame): more burst against bruisers
  • Top quest: free Unleashed Teleport and extra XP

Top tips

  • Poke melee top laners when they walk up to farm
  • Keep E ready for bruisers who dash onto you
  • Ward river; ganks come from the side
  • Use Unleashed Teleport to flank fights
  • Play safe against Akali and Yasuo
  • Build Zhonya's Hourglass against divers
